title: f1-0 color model plan — di/dwg node chain, opendrt, schema v2 design

commit.merge_subject: merge: f1-0 color model plan — di/dwg node chain, opendrt, schema v2 design

description:
Plan only, no code. Covers DI/DWG working space, N1 node chain with per-node spaces, OpenDRT v1.1.0 integration (C++ reference + GLSL, license note), ChainSlots/planChain changes (kPassNodes, 64 combos), schema 1->2 migration with field mapping, backup and atomic write, pixel parity strategy, S4 stabilization fold (no engine key = gyro), encoded source color definition (E0) link, F1-1..F1-8 breakdown and 14 open owner decisions.

Records plan/code contradictions, notably: the single Primary node, same pixels criterion cannot hold with log-space nodes (legacy block proposed), and eight stores stamp version=1 into project.json which would silently downgrade a v2 file. Unverified claims are marked.
changed: docs: add color model v2 (f1) design plan
